paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Mean absolute values before and after gating. The baseline and post-gating values are similar.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: This figure illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across layers, comparing values before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The X-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The Y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0. The title of the figure is "Hidden State Mean." Three lines are displayed. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed style, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0 at layer 0, shows small values around 0.2–0.3 through layers 2 to 8, then gradually increases through layers 10 to 15, reaching approximately 0.5 around layer 15, and then rises sharply from layer 18 onward, peaking at approximately 4.3 near layer 21 before dropping slightly to around 2.6 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted style, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, with only a very slight increase toward the final layers, staying below approximately 0.1. The third line, shown in green with a solid style, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it also remains very close to 0 across all layers, with a slight increase visible in the last few layers, reaching roughly 0.1 by layer 23. The orange and green lines are nearly overlapping and visually difficult to distinguish from each other across most of the layer range.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across layers for three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0. The first line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," is shown in blue with a dashed line style. It starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.25 near layers 3–7, dips slightly around layer 10 to approximately 0.2, then gradually increases through layers 10–17 reaching approximately 0.5, before rising sharply from around layer 18 onward, reaching a peak of approximately 4.4 at layer 22, with a notable dip around layer 21 to approximately 2.1 before rising again to around 2.6 at layer 23. The second line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," is shown in orange with a dotted line style. It remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, staying below approximately 0.1 across the entire range. The third line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," is shown in green with a solid line style. It also remains very close to 0 across all layers, closely tracking the orange line, with values staying below approximately 0.1.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the hidden state mean (absolute mean) across layers for three different conditions: before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0. The blue dashed line represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 by layers 3–7, remains relatively stable around 0.2 through layer 10, then increases gradually to approximately 0.5 around layer 17, before rising sharply to approximately 0.9 at layer 20, then jumping dramatically to about 2.2 at layer 21 and reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 across all layers, with only a very slight increase toward the later layers, staying below approximately 0.1 throughout. The green solid line represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it also remains very close to 0 across all layers, showing a very slight increase toward the final layers, reaching roughly 0.1 by layer 23. The orange dotted and green solid lines are nearly overlapping and remain close to zero throughout the entire layer range.
